name: Country Sub Division
definition: Sub division of a nation with its own government.

Province.name: Province
Province.definition: A territory governed as an administrative or political unit of a country.

Region.name: Region
Region.definition: Identification of an administrative division of a country, state, or territory.

DistrictSubDivision.name: District Sub Division
DistrictSubDivision.definition: Identification of a sub-division of a district.

State.name: State
State.definition: Organised political community or area forming a part of a federation.

District.name: District
District.definition: Name of a district, for example, a part of a town or region.
